description: B3: the Rootwarden asleep and rooted in his grove past the old root - a world boss held by his territory (world.greywood.rootwarden_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees only discovers the grove; a blow wakes him, and once the woodfolk call the giant (world.rootwarden.called) entering his hollow does; uprooted in his second phase he hunts to 130 m and walks home whole). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 300 m (reserve_seat) and his AI at the near tier within 400 m (lod_near_m), as Stoneback's. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
